map.Cohen Kappa 系数是做什么的？: What does Cohen's Kappa Coefficient do?
map.如何使用Cohen Kappa 系数？: How do I use Cohen's Kappa Coefficient?
map.Cohen Kappa 系数适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Cohen's Kappa Coefficient best for?
map.计算评价者一致性的 Cohen Kappa。: Compute Cohen's Kappa for rater agreement.
map.Cohen's Kappa 剔除\"偶然一致\"后衡量两个标注者（或模型与金标）: Cohen's Kappa measures the true agreement between two annotators (or a model and the gold standard) after removing "chance agreement": Pe is the probability they agree by random chance from their marginal distributions. kappa>0.8 is near-perfect, 0.4-0.6 moderate, below 0 means worse than random, so the annotation protocol needs re-alignment.
map.κ=(p_o−p_e)/(1−p_e)，p_o 为观测一致率，p_e 为随机一致: kappa=(p_o-p_e)/(1-p_e), where p_o is the observed agreement rate and p_e is the chance agreement rate (from marginal probabilities).
map.κ=1 完全一致，0 为仅随机一致，负值表示一致性差于随机。: kappa=1 perfect agreement, 0 is chance-only, negative means worse than chance.
map.用于标注一致性、诊断一致性等可靠性评估，比单纯准确率排除随机巧合。: Used for reliability assessment of annotation or diagnostic agreement; it excludes random coincidence better than raw accuracy.
map.两类各 100 例，观测一致 85 例 p_o=0.85；边际概率算得随机一致: Two classes of 100 cases each, observed agreement 85 cases p_o=0.85; marginal probabilities give chance agreement p_e=0.50 -> kappa=(0.85-0.50)/(1-0.50)=0.70, indicating substantial agreement.
map.kappa 和准确率差在哪？: How does kappa differ from accuracy?
map.准确率不剔除'瞎猜也能碰对'的巧合；kappa 用 p_e 扣除随机一致，更能反: Accuracy does not remove the coincidence of 'guessing right by luck'; kappa uses p_e to subtract chance agreement, better reflecting true agreement. The more imbalanced the classes, the higher p_e, the more kappa is needed.
map.kappa 多高算可靠？: How high is kappa considered reliable?
map.经验尺：0.01~0.20 轻微、0.21~0.40 一般、0.41~0.60: Empirical scale: 0.01-0.20 slight, 0.21-0.40 fair, 0.41-0.60 moderate, 0.61-0.80 substantial, 0.81-1.00 almost perfect; thresholds vary by domain.
